sections.what_happened: Pentagon sending USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group + 13th MEU (Makin Island ARG, ~10,000 troops) to CENTCOM, arrival end-November. Separately, FT reports Netanyahu ordered the IDF to prepare a multi-day bombing campaign on Iran for the weekend of Oct 10 (power plants, nuclear sites, leadership), shelved amid Trump opposition (didn't want restart before Nov 3 midterms). One source: 'There will either be a deal or an attack' post-midterms.
sections.what_verified: FT report relayed by JPost, Ynet, The National, Israel National News, The Standard HK (all crediting FT, Oct 21). Carrier: Fox origin corroborated by JPost, The Week, Firstpost, TOI, WSJ-origin relays. Context: Hegseth unannounced Israel visit Monday, Israeli officials presented updated target list (FT via relays). Iranian officials told Reuters preparing for renewed attacks.
sections.what_disputed: USNI News reports Roosevelt is moving to RELIEVE the George Washington, not add a sustained third carrier — 'third carrier' steady-state framing overstated; brief 3-carrier overlap possible at most. Pentagon and PMO declined FT comment. IRGC deputy cmdr Izadi (Fars, single-source) claims US naval forces pulled back ~700km to avoid Iranian missiles. Carrier-left-San-Diego Sep 27 / Yokosuka Oct 16-19 per USNI.
sections.why_matters: Deal-or-attack: the midterm pivot date. Netanyahu's shelved Oct-10 plan + Roosevelt deployment + Hegseth's Israel visit = post-Nov-3 decision window. Fair framing: USNI relief caveat kills the 'third carrier surge' hype; Iran's missile-deterrence counterclaim from Fars attributed.
sections.context: Background: US third carrier + Netanyahu shelved Iran offensive — NEW

totw_analysis: Our read: Deal-or-attack: the midterm pivot date. Netanyahu's shelved Oct-10 plan + Roosevelt deployment + Hegseth's Israel visit = post-Nov-3 decision window. Fair framing: USNI relief caveat kills the 'third carrier surge' hype; Iran's missile-deterrence counterclaim from Fars attributed. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deterrence or target list?
